description: When taskDescription is empty (bare 'otto' with no other text), attempt to infer intent from the surrounding thread: issue body, PR description, most recent human comments. If the issue or PR has a clear action-oriented description (e.g. a bug report, feature request, or TODO list), classify accordingly. If intent cannot be confidently determined, respond with a clarify status comment asking the user to be more specific. Never attempt a write operation on ambiguous bare invocations.
title: Bare otto intent inference with clarify fallback
